A man has been charged after allegedly punching a young boy and stabbing his mother with a pair of scissors in a random attack outside a police station, AAP reports. The man from Sunshine West, in the city’s inner west, was overnight charged with a series of assault-related offences including affray, intentionally causing injury, two counts of unlawful assault, conduct endangering life and conduct endangering serious injury. He was remanded to appear at Melbourne Magistrates’ Court on Wednesday. The boy and his mother, who were visiting from the Phillip Island township of Cowes, were taken to hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. Police do not believe the parties knew one another.

[Lähde: The Nightly | URL: https://thenightly.com.au/australia/victoria/melbourne-scissor-wielding-man-arrested-after-10-year-old-boy-assaulted-woman-stabbed-in-cbd-attack--c-22774327]
A woman was stabbed when she tried to shield the boy from the alleged attacker.

Victoria Police have arrested a scissor-wielding man after he allegedly assaulted a 10-year-old boy and stabbed a woman in a terrifying attack in Melbourne’s CBD.

Officers descended on Spencer Street near the corner of La Trobe street on Tuesday about 1pm after receiving reports a young boy had been assaulted.

Police said a woman, who was accompanying the boy, suffered stab wounds to her upper body as she tried to shield the boy from the alleged attacker.

Get the first look at the digital newspaper, curated daily stories and breaking headlines delivered to your inbox.

The pair were both taken to hospital with non life-threatening injuries.

“A woman with the boy at the time, intervened and was stabbed to the upper body,” Victoria Police said in a statement provided to The Nightly.

“The 10-year-old boy from Bass Coast area and the 30-year-old Cowes woman were hospitalised with non-life-threatening injuries.”

Police arrested a 27-year-old Sunshine West man a short time later nearby. They also seized a pair of scissors that were located on the man’s person.

Early reports suggest the pair were not known to the alleged attacker.

Detectives are continuing to investigate the incident as the man waits to be interviewed in policy custody.
